Antithesis | Washington, DC, London | Remote or In Office (US, UK) | Design Engineer

We create an expert system that verifies software and becomes an essential part of agentic workflows. https://antithesis.com

I’m Vlad, Director of Product Design, engineer, and manager. I’m looking for a design engineer to help build our design system https://anta.design, improve the UI of our apps, and improve AI’s ability to generate high-quality interfaces.

Send me a link to your website (it doesn’t have to be perfect; I just want to see what you’ve worked on). vlad.korobov@antithesis.com

There are other open roles, including SF: https://antithesis.com/company/careers/#open-roles
